parameters.content:
## Upload via HTTP Request
Webhook → HTTP Request (Google Drive API v3 multipart) → Postgres → Response

nodes.name: Subir a Google Drive
nodes.notes: SUBE ARCHIVO A GOOGLE DRIVE VIA API REST v3

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO document_versions (document_id, tenant_id, version_number, file_url, file_size, storage_provider, storage_path, metadata) VALUES ('{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.documentId }}', '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.tenantId }}', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1 FROM document_versions WHERE document_id = '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.documentId }}'), 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.gdriveFileId }}/view', 0, 'gdrive', '{{ $('Extract Metadata').item.json.gdriveFileId }}', '{"uploadedVia": "n8n-http"}') RETURNING id, version_number;
